description.zh: 配置服务器端加密规则的请求体。
description.en: The request body for configuring server-side encryption rules.

title.zh: 配置存储空间的加密规则
title.en: Configure the encryption rule for a bucket

descriptions.zh: 只有Bucket的拥有者及授权的RAM用户才能为Bucket设置加密规则，否则返回403错误。有关Bucket加密的更多信息，请参见[服务器端加密](~~31871~~)。
descriptions.en: Only the bucket owner and authorized RAM users can set encryption rules for a bucket. Otherwise, a 403 error is returned. For more information about bucket encryption, see [Server-side encryption](~~31871~~).
